signal: GoodShip raised a $25M Series B led by Greenfield Partners in Aug 2025 after 10x revenue growth, and Prime Inc. selected its platform in April 2026

email.body1:
Jessica, saw GoodShip's $25M Series B after 10x revenue growth and the Prime Inc. win this spring.

Growing that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for GoodShip off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jessica, quick follow-up for GoodShip.

Post-Series B, board expectations on enterprise pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GoodShip needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jessica, last bit of proof for GoodShip.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how GoodShip's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B logistics-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jessica, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise sprint to land more enterprise shippers is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to GoodShip either way.
